Build your dream team with a huge selection of players from the most popular leagues and clubs across the world, immersing yourself in the interactive simulation with strategic, turn-based gameplay that offers opportunities to attack, defend or shoot between a group of players on the pitch.

[EASY-TO-PICK-UP STRATEGIC TURN-BASED GAMEPLAY]
Collect and strengthen players and build your team to prepare for intense tactical football matches. Train players to master Skill Moves, unlock perfect Traits and increase player Rarity for further development. Customise your team with various items like Stadium, Kits, and Balls. Make strategic decisions on the pitch, adjust your tactics in real-time, and lead your team to victory.

[TEAM MANAGEMENT & AUTHENTICITY]
Unleash your manager skills and create champions thanks to the unrivalled authenticity. Build your team by choosing from over 5000 authentic football players, such as Erling Haaland, Son Heung-min, Jude Bellingham, Federico Chiesa, and Virgil van Dijk, from top global leagues, including Premier League, LALIGA EA SPORTS, Bundesliga, Ligue 1 Uber Eats, Serie A TIM, and more. 

[HYPER-REAL VISUAL EXPERIENCE]
Unleash your star power on the pitch with electric Skill Move animations that deliver a truly immersive football experience. Level up your players, increase their skills, and stun your opponents on the pitch.

[DIVERSE GAME MODES]
Enjoy a wide range of playable modes, from World Tour and Friendly Match to intense competitions such as Ranked Match. Also, don’t miss Limited-Time Matches that will not only let you gain valuable training experience to level up your players and team, but also bring you closer to real-world live events like the UEFA Champions League and UEFA EURO 2024™. Assemble your dream squad, analyse the field, and compete with opponents across different game modes. 

Football stardom awaits you. Step onto the pitch and embark on an all-new football adventure with EA SPORTS FC™ Tactical.
